backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a task management system with functions to add, remove, toggle, and retrieve tasks stored in a Map, where each task has text and checked status.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: task input interface, task list display with checkboxes, checked task styling, red text for unchecked tasks, and passive-aggressive modal on uncheck with visual theming.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing summaries of seven frontend files covering React Query hooks, todo input/list components, passive-aggressive modal, main app, and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes using warm earth tones, avoiding blue and purple colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference for the React application titled 'Daily Todo'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component rendering the todo app layout with header, TodoInput and TodoList components, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/PassiveAggressiv: Dialog modal component that displays a randomly selected passive-aggressive message from an array of 15 insults when a task is unchecked.
frontend/src/components/TodoInput.tsx: Form component with text input and submit button that adds new tasks using the useAddTask hook and clears input on success.
frontend/src/components/TodoList.tsx: Task list component that displays all tasks with checkboxes, applies red text styling to unchecked tasks, triggers passive-aggressive modal on uncheck, and shows loading/empty states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor with authentication, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching all tasks, adding a task, and toggling a task's completion state, all using the actor from useActor hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom warm earth-tone color palette for light and dark modes using OKLCH color space, plus base styling for body and borders.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH colors, border radius variables, custom shadows, Inter font family, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features (todo list with passive-aggressive unchecking behavior) and pending feature request to persist todos in the backend.
